s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of skin and muscle symptoms following immunotherapy
salient_findings: Prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 50s
Stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma with metastases
Developed skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab treatment
Received a second course of ipilimumab 14 months later
Physical findings include photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption
Diffuse erythema of forehead and midface
Erythema and edema of upper eyelids
Creatine kinase level increased to 1854 U/L
Aldolase level was 23.0 U/L
C-reactive protein level was 28.6 mg/L
Antinuclear antibody titer was 1:640 with speckled pattern
Jo-1 antibody was negative
MRI showed mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient developed skin symptoms and muscle weakness after immunotherapy, with elevated creatine kinase and characteristic skin findings

shortlist.label: Ipilimumab-induced myositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient received ipilimumab treatment and developed muscle symptoms, with biopsy showing atrophy of type II muscle fibers

shortlist.label: Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has stage IV malignant melanoma and developed dermatomyositis-like symptoms, suggesting a paraneoplastic syndrome

shortlist.label: Necrotizing autoimmune myopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has elevated creatine kinase and muscle weakness, with biopsy showing atrophy of type II muscle fibers, suggesting an autoimmune myopathy

shortlist.label: Amyopathic dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has characteristic skin findings of dermatomyositis, but muscle biopsy did not show inflammatory myositis, suggesting an amyopathic variant

raw.rationale: The patient's skin symptoms, such as photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption, diffuse erythema of forehead and midface, and erythema of upper eyelids, along with elevated creatine kinase and aldolase levels, and muscle biopsy showing atrophy of type II muscle fibers, are consistent with dermatomyositis. The presence of antinuclear antibody titer with a speckled pattern also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Mixed Connective Tissue Disease
rejected.why: Lack of specific features such as arthritis, sclerodactyly, or esophageal dysmotility

rejected.label: Necrotizing Autoimmune Myopathy
rejected.why: Muscle biopsy did not show necrotic fibers, and the clinical presentation is not typical for this condition

rejected.label: Polymyositis
rejected.why: Absence of skin symptoms in polymyositis, which is a key distinguishing feature from dermatomyositis

rejected.label: Myositis
rejected.why: Myositis is a broad term that encompasses several conditions, including dermatomyositis and polymyositis, but the patient's skin symptoms and other findings are more specific for dermatomyositis
